;Art and culture
*The [[Spanish government]] passes a decree which amends the [[Historical Memory Law]] to allow the government to exhume [[Francisco Franco]]'s remains from the [[Valle de los Caídos]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/general-franco-valley-fallen-spain-body-exhumed-fascist-dictator-a8506541.html (''The Independent'')]

;Business and economy
*Two weeks after [[Elon Musk]] expressed his intentions of making [[Tesla, Inc.]] [[Privately held company|private]], he and the company's [[Board of directors|board]] announce that the company will remain publicly [[Listing (finance)|listed]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/08/25/641803323/tesla-to-remain-public-elon-musk-says (NPR)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A bus plunges off a bridge onto a train track due to a malfunction near [[Kuopio]], [[Finland]], killing four people and injuring 20 others. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/four_die_in_bus_accident_in_eastern_finland/10369857 (Yle News)] 

;International relations
*[[2017–18 North Korea crisis]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] asks his [[Secretary of State (United States)|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] to cancel a planned trip to [[North Korea]], citing the country's insufficient progress in denuclearizing the Korean peninsula. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/08/24/trump-cancels-pompeo-trip-to-north-korea-cites-lack-of-sufficient-progress-on-denuclearization.html (CNBC)]"
*[[Palestine–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] redirects more than $200 million in aid for the [[Palestinian National Authority]] to "high priority projects elsewhere". The [[Palestine Liberation Organization]] denounces the "use of cheap blackmail as a political tool". [http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2018/08/24/us-cuts-aid-to-palestinians-by-more-than-200-million.html (Fox News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Liberal Party of Australia leadership spills, 2018]]
**[[Australia]]n [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Malcolm Turnbull]] loses spill motion and resigns. [https://news.sky.com/video/malcolm-turnbull-resigns-as-australian-prime-minister-11480575 (Sky News)]
**Treasurer [[Scott Morrison]] wins the second leadership spill, 45 votes to 40 against [[Peter Dutton]], and becomes Prime Minister. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-08-24/live-turnbull-leadership-challenge-looms/10159462 (ABC)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Representatives from 12 [[European Union]] countries do not reach an agreement on [[Italy]]'s request to take in the 150 migrants still remaining on the [[Diciotti-class offshore patrol vessel|''Diciotti''-class vessel]] in [[Catania]], [[Sicily]], after their rescue by the [[Corps of the Port Captaincies – Coast Guard|Italian Coast Guard]] nine days ago. [https://www.dw.com/en/italy-clashes-with-eu-over-diciotti-migrant-boat/a-45215364 (Deutsche Welle)] [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2018/08/24/consequences-from-eu-migrant-decisions_5dcdb573-d40f-4f36-8e7a-3804a028389e.html (ANSA)]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 2018]]
**The electoral commission publishes the list of approved candidates. [[Jean-Pierre Bemba]] and two former prime ministers are excluded. [http://uk.businessinsider.com/r-congo-rejects-presidential-bid-of-opposition-leader-bemba-2018-8 (Reuters via ''Business Insider'')]
*[[Corruption in Venezuela]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**A [[United States]] court case gains new evidence and a guilty plea in relation to investigations of [[corruption]] and [[money laundering]] in [[Venezuela]], adding a group who are suspected to be relatives of Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]] to the list of suspected accomplices. [http://uk.businessinsider.com/ap-maduros-stepsons-face-scrutiny-in-12-billion-graft-case-2018-8 (''Business Insider'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/sources-us-prosecutors-relatives-venezuelas-maduro-benefited-12-57384718 (ABC News)]
*[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[John McCain]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[Arizona|AZ]]) has announced that he will not continue his cancer treatment. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2018/08/24/politics/john-mccain-cancer-treatment/index.html (CNN)]
